levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن خالد البرقي

notes: «حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه» : the father, a bare relation; the blessing is left out
«يرفعه إلى» marks the gap in the chain (rule 8): an unnamed link at its place
the Imam named after the gap is inside the chain, so he is a narrator and the last link; the saying follows «أنه قال»
